custom_expert_mcp_server_form_schema.source: Add custom expert drawer → MCP Servers (Optional) → Add MCP Server sub-form

tool_lifecycle_visibility.tool_introspection_ui: NONE — Corti Console does not expose a per-MCP-server tool list. The user cannot see which JSON-RPC methods (tools) an MCP server exposes without invoking it at runtime.
tool_lifecycle_visibility.tool_call_visibility_in_chat_ui: NONE — agent detail page chat shows only user message → assistant response; no intermediate tool-call logs visible (confirmed by §7.3.3 test run)
tool_lifecycle_visibility.tool_call_trace_endpoint: NOT OBSERVED in the agent detail page UI. The 200-OK runtime GET to api.eu.corti.app/agents/registry/experts is the registry fetch only; no per-run trace endpoint surfaced in the agent detail page UI.

flow: 1. User sends A2A v0.3 Message{role:user, parts:[{text, kind:text}], messageId, kind:message}
2. Runtime constructs orchestrator LLM context: Agent.systemPrompt + each attached Expert.description as tool definition + user Message
3. Orchestrator LLM either: (a) directly produces output text (no tool call), or (b) emits tool_call(s) to invoke one or more Experts
4. For invoked Experts with bound MCP servers: runtime dispatches JSON-RPC tool call to the MCP server (with resolved auth header per Authorization Type)
5. MCP server returns tool result; appended to shared session context
6. Orchestrator LLM re-invokes with updated context (ReAct loop, possibly multiple rounds)
7. Final response returned as A2A v0.3 Message{role:assistant, parts:[...]}

tool_state_distinguisher.TOOL_CONFIGURED: User has added the MCP server to an Expert via the Add custom expert drawer (visible in agent JSON Config as mcpServers[] entry)
tool_state_distinguisher.TOOL_AVAILABLE: Runtime resolves the MCP server URL + auth_type, confirms reachability (this is NOT visible in UI; happens at runtime)
tool_state_distinguisher.TOOL_INVOKED: Orchestrator LLM emitted a tool_call to this Expert's bound MCP server during a run (NOT visible in chat UI per §7.3.3)
tool_state_distinguisher.TOOL_RESULT_CONSUMED: Tool result was used by the orchestrator LLM in synthesizing the final response (NOT visible in chat UI)
